svg.title: Tier ranking, one search per key
svg.desc: Dark Knight, level 90, item level 660, a GCD of exactly 2.30 with Nachos. Search 1 (a full search, 12 nodes) finds the most Critical Hit, 2,310 with food (29.3%, a tier starting at 2,309), and holds it at 2,310 or more; it proves at most 2,164 gear points of Critical Hit, a regain cut for searches 2 to 4. Search 2 (a trial search, 764 nodes) finds the most Determination with that hold, 1,288 (+9.4%, a tier starting at 1,276), and holds it at 1,277 or more; it proves at most 1,288, a regain cut for searches 3 and 4. Search 3 (a trial search, 2,648 nodes) finds the most Direct Hit with both holds: 0, and proves it, a regain cut for search 4. Search 4 (a trial search, 5,262 nodes) ranks by raw totals under all three holds and every proof: Critical Hit 2,310, Determination 1,288, Direct Hit 0.
svg.text: Tier ranking: one search per key, each holding the keys before it

Each search after the first starts from the set before it. A search stopped at its node limit proves nothing.
